messages:
rose: quick note - found parity bug: REST honors ?boost=true on /v1/search but the node sdk sends boost in body so server ignores it and results differ. repro below.

rose: curl (blocking):
```
curl 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/search?boost=true' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"q":"foo"}'
# -> boosted results
```

rose: node-sdk (broken):
```
await client.search.run({ q: 'foo', boost: true }) // SDK serializes boost in JSON body, server reads only query param
// -> unboosted results
```

diego: thanks, this matches several flaky e2e failures in onboarding. quick fix: map boost -> query param in the high-level wrapper and add unit test. also audit codegen templates for query vs body param tags.

anya: can we be tolerant and accept both ?boost=true and body.boost on server side? add small compatibility layer and a test.

devex-bot: Created issue #4321: "node-sdk: map search.boost to ?boost query param; audit query/body mapping" assigned to diego, priority: medium. https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/4321 :white_check_mark:

rose: I'll add a quick e2e in sampleapp CI to call search with boost=true to catch this going forward.
